evidence.quote: private readonly bookings = new Map<string, Booking>();

responsibilities.description: Keeps bookings in an in-memory store. It creates bookings with generated identifiers, looks them up by id, updates them and lists all of them.
responsibilities.name: Store and retrieve bookings in memory

responsibilities.description: Maintains a secondary index from each session to its bookings, so all bookings for a given session can be retrieved quickly.
responsibilities.name: Index bookings by session
